svg.title: Saga (Choreography)
svg.desc: Saga (Choreography). Services react to each other's events to complete a workflow, with no central coordinator. Step 1, An event starts it: Orders saves order #1042 as PENDING and publishes OrderPlaced. It tells nobody what to do next. Step 2, React and publish: Each service reacts, commits locally and publishes the next event, until Orders marks CONFIRMED. Step 3, A failure is an event too: Out of stock: Inventory publishes StockReservationFailed. Payments refunds; Orders cancels. Step 4, Nobody sees the whole flow: Every event carries the order ID, so a tracking view can rebuild a saga and flag a stuck one.

g.text: 3 · A failure is an event too
3 · A failure is an event too
Orders saves order #1042 as PENDING and publishes OrderPlaced. It tells nobody what to do next.
Each service reacts, commits locally and publishes the next event, until Orders marks CONFIRMED.
Out of stock: Inventory publishes StockReservationFailed. Payments refunds; Orders cancels.
Every event carries the order ID, so a tracking view can rebuild a saga and flag a stuck one.
